exact_pairwise_rule: Complete 2x2 or intervention-equivalent matched family under fixed material G,E, with joint action rejecting every main-effect-only reconstruction.
higher_order_rule: No 3X/4X claim without enough prospectively frozen lower-order cells to reject every lower-order reconstruction.
geometry_rule: Same-X varied-G controls are mandatory for any claimed geometry-conditioned generalization.
domain_escape_rule: Bot/workflow-only evidence cannot satisfy P18. At least one exact non-bot family is required for any PASS_DOMAIN_ESCAPE verdict; two semantic transport families are required for replicated edge authority.
negative_custody_rule: Failed candidates, one-domain interactions, confounded families and incomplete factorials must be materialized rather than silently dropped.
solid_rule: SOLID-as-special-case remains a long-horizon hypothesis only; P18 cannot use SOLID terminology to define or rescue a primitive or interaction.
paper_rule: Track paper readiness and novelty, but do not draft or freeze a manuscript thesis.
harvest_rule: Harvest remains non-sovereign and may generate tests, kill novelty, or donate fragments across Labs; it cannot promote a P18 scientific claim.
law_r2_gate: Only a fresh materially normalized same-(X,G,E) conflicting action surviving full interaction/geometry/provenance reconstruction may reopen LAW-R2.
